title: PiPER X physically constrained minimum-base dynamics identification
source_model: models/piper_x.urdf + models/nominal_x.json via archived MuJoCo model and regressor

measured_position_mapping.conversion: CAN degrees to radians, direct joint index

geometry_constraint_manifest.geometry_model: collision-mesh convex hull; link6 includes flange and gripper meshes at URDF positions over the stated prismatic limits
limitations: The mesh hull is an outer support bound, not a measured internal mass distribution.
The 10 mm default margin accommodates collision-mesh and hardware differences.
Link6 geometry spans the Xacro finger limits; the fitted inertial model still uses the nominal closed-gripper aggregate.

method.base_parameterization: theta = S(V beta + V0 gamma), beta = V.T @ S^-1 @ theta, tau = (Y S V) beta; S uses nominal CAD characteristic scales
method.estimation: Per-joint-target-RMS-normalized weighted least squares, jointly re-fitting the identifiable minimum-base coordinates and the standard-parameter nullspace realization; six link inertias are constrained by pseudo-inertia LMIs and dissipative friction coefficients are constrained nonnegative.
method.loss_scale: target torque RMS by joint, computed on the fit split; validation uses the same training scales

physical_constraints.pseudo_inertia: P_i=[[0.5 tr(I_O) I-I_O,h],[h.T,m]]; congruence-scaled P_i >= 1e-9 I
physical_constraints.mass_bounds: 0.5 to 1.5 times the snapshot CAD mass per link
physical_constraints.com_geometry: COM constrained to the exact PiPER X collision-mesh convex hull expanded outward by 0.01 m; link6 includes flange and gripper meshes over the Xacro prismatic joint ranges
physical_constraints.second_moment_geometry: each diagonal entry of the pseudo-inertia second-moment matrix is bounded by the mass times the squared radius of an expanded AABB enclosing the same mesh geometry
physical_constraints.friction: viscous and smooth Coulomb coefficients >= 0; offset signed

method.cad_prior: mean link-wise log-det Bregman divergence D(P||P_CAD)=tr(P_CAD^-1 P)-logdet(P_CAD^-1/2 P P_CAD^-1/2)-4, plus a weak normalized friction magnitude penalty
method.selection_rule: minimum mean held-out per-joint RMSE normalized by training target RMS among physically feasible candidates; tie-break on overall held-out relative error

unconstrained_minimum_base_OLS.evidence: A separate closest-to-CAD solve with the training OLS base vector fixed was infeasible even with pseudo-inertia PSD only; the base target therefore must be refit inside the physical set rather than projected after OLS.

limitations: The 24-dimensional standard-parameter nullspace means per-link mass/COM/inertia are not uniquely determined by this torque dataset. The reported link values are one feasible realization selected by the explicit CAD prior and bounds.

Physical constraints changed the 54-dimensional training base vector by 71.8% in relative norm from unconstrained OLS; similar validation error does not make the resulting per-link values measured or unique.

The following links reach a configured mass, COM mesh-hull, or second-moment geometry bound: link2, link4, link5, link6. Bound-active values indicate the result is constraint-limited and should not be treated as independently measured parameters.
当前电流到力矩比例来自 SDK 型号参考值，未在这台机械臂上校准。
采集时曾报告底座/桌面运动，但没有测量；固定基座动力学模型无法区分这类扰动。
质量 0.5–1.5 倍 CAD 是显式先验，不是本台机械臂的实测值；网格约束来自官方碰撞几何的外包络，不描述连杆内部真实密度分布。
快照模型的 link6 在闭合夹爪姿态下合并了夹爪惯性。
验证数据来自同一段 120 秒记录的完整留出周期，不是另一次独立采集。
网格外包络加入了明确的几何膨胀裕量；link6 的几何同时覆盖夹爪开度范围，但惯性先验仍按闭合夹爪聚合值计算。
